grammar:
char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1F] | [\\] (["\\bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})
ref-defs-PictureProposal ::= "{" space ref-defs-PictureProposal-title-kv "," space ref-defs-PictureProposal-approach-kv space "}"
ref-defs-PictureProposal-approach ::= "\"" char{20} char* "\""
ref-defs-PictureProposal-approach-kv ::= "\"approach\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PictureProposal-approach
ref-defs-PictureProposal-title ::= "\"" char+ "\""
ref-defs-PictureProposal-title-kv ::= "\"title\"" space ":" space ref-defs-PictureProposal-title
response-format-schema ::= "{" space response-format-schema-picture-1-kv "," space response-format-schema-picture-2-kv "," space response-format-schema-collection-rationale-kv "," space response-format-schema-uncertainties-kv space "}"
response-format-schema-collection-rationale ::= "\"" char{20} char* "\""
response-format-schema-collection-rationale-kv ::= "\"collection_rationale\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-collection-rationale
response-format-schema-picture-1 ::= ref-defs-PictureProposal
response-format-schema-picture-1-kv ::= "\"picture_1\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-picture-1
response-format-schema-picture-2 ::= ref-defs-PictureProposal
response-format-schema-picture-2-kv ::= "\"picture_2\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-picture-2
response-format-schema-uncertainties ::= "[" space (response-format-schema-uncertainties-item ("," space response-format-schema-uncertainties-item){0,5})? space "]"
response-format-schema-uncertainties-item ::= "\"" char* "\""
response-format-schema-uncertainties-kv ::= "\"uncertainties\"" space ":" space response-format-schema-uncertainties
root ::= response-format-schema
space ::= [ \t\n\r]*

transformation.changed: Defer only sampler string maxLength; retain all complete source schema bytes and SHA binding
transformation.unchanged: JSON types, exact keys, required members, enum, string minLength and every array minItems/maxItems
transformation.method: Deterministic GBNF for one of six exact SHA-bound fixed-picture schemas; all assigned picture keys, required per-picture title/approach, collection rationale and 0..6 uncertainties are retained.
transformation.length_scope: Only string maxLength is omitted from sampler GBNF to avoid the installed 6703d7894 repetition parser boundary. String minLength and all array minItems/maxItems remain enforced by this grammar. The complete original schema, text system/prompt and host Pydantic retain every string maximum; overlong responses must be rejected without truncation or repair.
transformation.input_scope: Text-only proposals for the host-assigned exact picture count. Fixed keys do not certify one coherent picture per entry, artistic difference, quality, identity or user approval.
transformation.source_runtime_scope: Shared installed DLL diagnostic reference only; no fixed-picture inference or model weights are loaded by this derivation.
